summary: Line runs through a wooded strip between houses; no road or room to stop.
reasons: No road or track under the line

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 6 m at the north end and 11-13 m along the rest; homes on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: The line passes through dense trees with no sealed surface, tyre tracks or pull-off; only the last few metres meet the Volga Crescent bend.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time and 4P Parallel signs sit 12 m off the line, on the nearby street.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign nearby
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the whole line.
cannot_judge: Whether a footpath or easement runs through the trees
